g.text: Week 6 — Add a normal task (main success scenario)
Factory has created and injected the service's storage.
Saved records are loaded and action callbacks are bound.
type "Buy milk" and click Add Task
trim, check length, preserve long-list warning
bind action callbacks; flash new row
saved task visible in To do
Short descriptions return null with no save or redraw.
Urgent additions use addUrgentTask() and the builder's
high-priority / URGENT-label recipe, not a type string.
